Use public evidence links rather than leaked material. No tokens, personal data,
private security details or unmarked plot spoilers. Read the
[evidence guide](https://github.com/ayushcmd/waytodoomsday/blob/main/docs/doomsday-evidence.md).

### Affected page and record ID / character / actor / variant

### Current claim and proposed correction

### Evidence URLs, publisher, publication date and date checked

Prefer primary Marvel/Disney evidence. Explain contradictory statements, denials
or retractions. A TMDB portrait or prior role is not casting evidence.

### Proposed evidence tier and why

Confirmed / official preview / reported / speculation / actor-only role undisclosed.
Do not infer a named role from an actor-only listing.

### Reproduction context

Browser/device and steps if the correction concerns displayed behavior.

### Checks

- [ ] I searched existing issues and supplied verifiable sources.
- [ ] I distinguished character variants and uncertainty.
- [ ] I removed private information and marked any necessary spoilers.
